q: The concept of a Lyapunov exponent generalizes to infinite-dimensional systems via the Oseledets multiplicative ergodic theorem, which guarantees:
opts: Finitely many Lyapunov exponents equal to the dimension of the attractor
A discrete spectrum of Lyapunov exponents for the linearized cocycle over an ergodic measure
Uniform hyperbolicity of the global attractor
exp: Oseledets MET applies to measurable cocycles over ergodic systems, giving a splitting of the tangent space into Oseledets subspaces with well-defined exponential growth rates (Lyapunov exponents).
